lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: In 2008, Elon Musk had three failed rockets, and money for one last try.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Tesla was running out of cash. His marriage was over.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then rocket number four reached orbit. NASA called with a 1.6 billion dollar contract. And on Christmas Eve, Tesla was saved.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: After that? Rockets that land themselves. A car in space. And an armored Cybertruck window that smashed on stage. Twice.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: He bought Twitter for 44 billion dollars, and renamed it X.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: And in 2026, SpaceX's record stock market debut made him the first trillionaire in history.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Not bad for a kid who sold his first space game for five hundred dollars.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: His full story is on Unfiled Films.
